name: ssht
title: Ssht
description: Search and connect OpenSSH config hosts through ssht.
author: dong

commands.name: search-hosts
commands.title: Ssht - Search SSH Hosts
commands.description: Search OpenSSH config hosts and connect through ssht.

preferences.name: sshtPath
preferences.title: ssht Path
preferences.description: Path to the ssht executable. Use an absolute path if Raycast cannot find ssht on PATH.

preferences.name: configPath
preferences.title: SSH Config Path
preferences.description: Optional path to an OpenSSH config file. Leave empty to use ~/.ssh/config.

preferences.name: noInclude
preferences.title: Disable Include Parsing
preferences.description: Ignore Include directives while listing hosts.
preferences.label: Ignore Include directives

preferences.name: terminal
preferences.title: Terminal
preferences.description: Terminal backend used by ssht when opening a connection.

preferences.name: openMode
preferences.title: Open Mode
preferences.description: Whether ssht should use automatic iTerm split detection, a new tab, or a new window.
